Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
Ok, so I go out and buy some boxes for the first time in a
*very* long time. One of the boxes I got was Ancient Hearts.
I'm opening all the packs excitedly hopeing to get a few of
Blood Agony and Silence of Death (*gasp* not RtI or ToRIII?
uhh, no). As I'm opening many of these packs, I notice that
they do not contain a Rare card. Which leads me to ask
any who are knowledgable, how many rares come in a booster
of AH?
Of the box of 45 boosters, I ended up with 34 Rares. I thought
that it was supposed to be 1 rare per booster? I'm really
ticked off and I want to find out definitively whether or not I
was ripped (which would suck because a box of AH is $60).
If I was supposed to get 1 Rare/booster, do I have any recourse?

Sorrow

Some of the packs have two uncommons, some have one uncommon and
one rare. (If they all had one uncommon and one rare, then there
would be no difference between "rare" and "uncommon").
